example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে দুই দলের মধ্যে ঠেঙ্গাবাজী শুরু হয়ে গেছে।
সে ঠেঙ্গাবাজী করে তার শত্রুকে পরাজিত করল।
example_sentences_in_english: A stick fight broke out between the two groups in the village.
He defeated his enemy through a brawl with sticks.
note: This idiom reflects traditional rural conflicts in Bengali culture, often associated with village disputes.
